approved: Automatically select the first available competition on entry. Browse ten questions per page; pagination follows the last question and resets scroll to the top. Select one option and explicitly submit with Answer. Correct and incorrect feedback identifies the correct choice and, when wrong, the user's choice. A confirmed answer is read-only on the current page. Changing page or competition, or closing the application, discards responses. On submission failure keep the choice and allow another submission; prevent duplicates while pending. Retry reloads a failed question list. A Ghost sidebar trigger is available across workspace states. On desktop, the collapse icon remains visible while expanded; when collapsed, the expand icon is hidden at pointer rest and revealed on rail/header hover or keyboard focus, without moving the layout. Activation, not hover, expands the sidebar. A visible accessible alternative is required on touch/no-hover devices. Collapse/expand preserves current page, selection, scroll context and answers.
open: Question ordering, empty-sidebar presentation, exact responsive breakpoint and phone drawer treatment (including its open state), navigation-list data source and recovery, ambiguous submission outcomes, and production localization remain open. The phone layout, sidebar loading and sidebar failure are proposals. No runtime, usability or accessibility conformance is claimed.

notes.information-architecture:
**Current workspace — v0.1.0**
One destination: left competition sidebar, right scrolling question list. First available competition selected by default. Label: Name · Year · Position/exam; full label discoverable. Ghost trigger: visible expanded; collapsed expand icon revealed on hover/focus, with touch fallback. Activation changes layout; hover alone does not. Collapse preserves page and answers. Ten questions per page, footer pagination. Phone and navigation loading/failure are proposals. No additional routes. Exact breakpoint, drawer, ordering and data recovery remain open.

notes.user-flows:
**Current flows — v0.1.0**
Entry -> first available item -> question loading -> list / empty / failure.
Select -> Answer -> pending -> confirmed and locked OR failure (choice retained; Answer enabled).
Page or competition change -> discard current answers -> load target; page scroll resets. Exit -> discard answers. Collapsed pointer hover/focus -> reveal expand control; activate -> expand; preserve current context. Touch/no-hover requires visible alternative. Ten questions per page. Question-list Retry is distinct from proposed navigation-list Retry. Phone drawer, uncertain outcomes and keyboard/touch behavior remain open.
